name: motoserver_apply_patch_and_restart
description: Safely applies a code modification to a file on MotoServer with automatic timestamped backup, python syntax validation, and optional PM2 service restart.

patch_type.description: Type of patch to apply. Defaults to 'replace_marker'.

replacement_content.description: The replacement or appended code content.

restart_service.description: PM2 service name to restart upon success (e.g. 'dashboard', 'ttyd', or 'none'). Defaults to 'dashboard'.

search_content.description: Exact text chunk to search for when patch_type is 'replace_marker'.

target_file.description: Absolute path of the target file on MotoServer.
